2608.26090.title: Finding and using interpretable latents in a neutrino foundation model with sparse autoencoders
2608.26090.paper_summary: We present a first application of sparse-autoencoder-based mechanistic interpretability to particle physics. Studying a neutrino foundation model pretrained on IceCube data and fine-tuned for direction reconstruction, we identify a validated atlas of physical concepts in the model representation, using a strict validation protocol consisting of held-out tests, matched nuisance controls, and replication across independent dictionary trainings. Causal interventions show that the direction head barely draws on this atlas. Motivated by this underused information, we train an uncertainty head on the same event-level representation to predict the model's angular reconstruction error. Unlike the direction head, it depends causally on quality and brightness features from the atlas. At $20\%$ selection efficiency, this interpretable estimator improves the median angular resolution from $20.2^\circ$ to $3.2^\circ$. These results suggest that mechanistic interpretability can reveal learned latent physics encoded within a model's internal representation and help design downstream tasks that exploit it.
2608.26090.paper_summary_zh: 我們展示了基於稀疏自編碼器的機制可解釋性在粒子物理學中的首次應用。<lb/>研究一個在 IceCube 數據上預訓練並針對方向重建進行微調的中微子基礎模型，我們在模型表示中識別出一個經過驗證的物理概念圖譜，使用了一個嚴格的驗證協議，包括保留測試、匹配的干擾控制和在獨立字典訓練中的重複驗證。<lb/>因果干預顯示方向頭幾乎不依賴於這個圖譜。<lb/>受到這些未充分利用的信息的啟發，我們在相同的事件級表示上訓練了一個不確定性頭，以預測模型的角度重建誤差。<lb/>與方向頭不同，它在因果上依賴於來自圖譜的質量和亮度特徵。<lb/>在 $20\%$ 的選擇效率下，這個可解釋的估計器將中位角度解析度從 $20.2^\circ$ 改善到 $3.2^\circ$。<lb/>這些結果表明，機制可解釋性可以揭示模型內部表示中編碼的學習潛在物理，並幫助設計利用這些信息的下游任務。
